::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 7th [mid 1860s?]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

[To [Robert Harrison](people/person_635.qmd), the Librarian of the [London Library](organizations/other_29.qmd)]

Miss Yonge returns the books she has had of late, and would be glad to have the undermentioned sent to her

Richardson’s [Clarissa](other_books/otherbook_565.qmd)
Ottilie Wildemuth [Heimath der Frau](other_books/otherbook_566.qmd)

Bucknill [Psychology of Shakespeare](other_books/otherbook_567.qmd)

Aytoun [Ballads of Scotland](other_books/otherbook_568.qmd)

Wilson [Memoirs of Edinburgh](other_books/otherbook_569.qmd)

Mme D’Arblay [Life](other_books/otherbook_570.qmd)

[The Poor Artist](other_books/otherbook_571.qmd)

Wilmott’s [Journal of Summer time in Country](other_books/otherbook_572.qmd)
